text:
alex: noticed a weird drop in prefix prefetch hit-rate for open-llama-13b, eu-west-1, route /v1/chat/stream for tenant carto. hits went from ~62% → 18% in last 2h.

maria: whoa, saw a correlated increase in p99 latency? :eyes:

alex: yes p99 token latency up ~45ms, throughput steady. token-saved metric dropped accordingly. here's the quick grafana query i used:

alex: ```promql
sum by(tenant,model,route) (prefix_cache_hits_total{region="eu-west-1"}) /
(sum by(tenant,model,route) (prefix_cache_hits_total{region="eu-west-1"}) +
 sum by(tenant,model,route) (prefix_cache_misses_total{region="eu-west-1"}))
``` 

sam: runtime-bot posted a profiler snapshot for the timeframe — looks like kernel-selector changed to avx2_fallback at 11:07 UTC

runtime-bot: profiling: snapshot id=ps-202406xx-1107, hotpath=kv_read_lock -> batch_coalesce -> kernel_select(avx2_fallback) (attached)

jin: any recent rollout/PRs touching batching heuristics or kv keying? I recall a PR that changed prefetch jitter.

maria: PR #3124 changed dynamic-batch-thresholds and also tweaked prefix-key hashing to include normalized timestamps. rolled at 10:58 UTC.

sam: if hash includes timestamp normalization, key entropy could increase → lower cache hit-rate. that would explain tenant-level drop.

alex: action: rollback PR #3124 for eu-west-1 canary, add alert on token-saved % drop > 20% per tenant.

maria: +1. i'll queue rollback and add a temporary grafana panel: tenant_token_saved_ratio and a heatmap for key_entropy_by_tenant. quick panel query:

maria: ```sql
SELECT tenant, model, route, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cache_hit) / COUNT(*) as hit_rate,
       approx_entropy(prefix_key) as key_entropy
FROM prefix_cache_events
WHERE ts > now() - interval '6 hours'
GROUP BY tenant, model, route;
``` 

jin: also adding an observability alert: when per-tenant hit_rate drops by 25% vs 3h baseline AND p99 token latency > baseline + 30ms → page oncall.

ops-bot: created alert alert-PR3124-prefetch-hitrate-drop with threshold=25%, severity=high, notify=#eng-oncall

sam: long-term: we need a test harness to simulate keying jitter and measure hit-rate impact across models. file an RFC?

alex: opened ticket RW-6090: 'simulate prefix-key entropy changes + hit-rate regression test' assigned to eng-runtime.

maria: follow-up: add a dashboard column for kernel-selection breakdown per model (kernel=avx2, avx2_fallback, cuda_kernels) — might surface regressions like this earlier.

alex: thanks all. will monitor after rollback. :thumbsup:
